steps.executor_prompt: Interaction safety: Never press Android Back while Chrome is foregrounded. Do not use Android Recents or browser history. Never reuse a UI index after the screen changes; end the action batch and re-observe before taking another indexed action. Leave Chrome by pressing Home, then open Google Authenticator by app name. If there is a device PIN, enter {device_pin}. Navigate to the main page of Google Authenticator where the OTP can be found: for a mail or messaging app this is the inbox or conversation list, and for an authenticator app this is the list of accounts with their codes. Do not rely on memory or any previously seen OTP code; obtain a fresh one from the current screen. Within Google Authenticator, if a message detail is open, use that app's own navigation control to return to the inbox rather than Android Back. If the app shows messages or emails, refresh the inbox, wait 3 seconds, re-observe, and open the newest item belonging to Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login. If the app directly displays rotating codes, find the entry corresponding to Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login; if its code is about to expire, wait for it to rotate and read the new code. Report that OTP code as the final answer.

Interaction safety: Never press Android Back while Chrome is foregrounded, including to hide the keyboard, close a prompt, return from another app, or navigate. Do not use Android Recents or browser history. Never reuse a UI index after the screen changes. After launching or switching apps, navigating, submitting a form, or otherwise changing the screen, end the action batch and re-observe before taking another indexed action. In Google Authenticator, record the currently displayed fresh code for Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login before leaving; if Google Authenticator is locked and offers device PIN entry, enter {device_pin}, submit, and re-observe the code source. Press Home and launch Chrome again by app name so it resumes its existing tab. Re-observe and verify the exact target represented by Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login before acting. If a different tab is active, use Chrome's tab switcher to select the existing target tab; if no target tab exists, navigate directly to the target URL, never through Back or browser history. If the native credential form is visible, enter {user}, re-observe, manually enter {password}, re-observe, submit using only the latest UI index, and re-observe. Select the authenticator-app verification method only if the OTP field is not already visible, then re-observe. When the OTP field is visible, clear it, enter {otp_code} without spaces, submit, and re-observe separately. If credential recovery consumed substantial time or the code is rejected as invalid or expired, press Home, open Google Authenticator, obtain a newly rotated code for Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login, press Home, reopen Chrome by app name, verify the exact target and OTP field, and immediately submit the new code. Report success only after a separate observation shows authenticated account-specific content or an explicit login-success confirmation for Default Browser and go to accounts.evernote.com/login.
